ai_review.summary: The supplied audit evidence confirms that the cookie banner's rejection option was successfully used, but it does not list any subsequent network requests, cookies, storage, advertising, profiling or analytics activity. On the evidence provided, no specific unlawful collection finding can therefore be made. The policies provide broad information about purposes, legal bases, recipients, retention and rights.
evidence: E1: Cookie banner found: True. Reject clicked successfully: True. Method: selector. Buttons clicked: Reject all cookies.

E2: Pages browsed and scrolled after reject: https://www.wpp.com/en/case-studies, https://www.wpp.com/en/case-studies/the-room-nike-akqa-how-nike-reimagined-a-product-launch-as-a-training-ground-for-ambition, https://www.wpp.com/en/case-studies/review-routes-tiktok-akqa-how-tiktok-turned-daily-commutes-into-a-powerful-learning-journey.
E3: Privacy policy: https://www.wpp.com/en/privacy-policy. Companies it names: none extracted. Contact email found: enquiries@wpp.com.

controller_identity.label: Who is responsible (the controller)
controller_identity.quote: In this privacy policy, references “WPP”, “us”, “we” or “our”, are all references to WPP.

purposes.label: What the data is used for
purposes.quote: To keep you updated with developments and initiatives at WPP, its affiliates or partners

lawful_basis.label: The legal basis for using it
lawful_basis.quote: Our legitimate interests – we use your information to provide you news and updates on WPP, its affiliates or partners.

recipients.label: Who it is shared with
recipients.quote: We may send your personal information to other group companies, affiliates and third parties to help us process your personal information for the purposes set out in this policy.

retention.label: How long it is kept
retention.quote: We only keep your personal information for as long as we need to, to be able to use it for reasons given in this privacy policy, and for as long as we are required to keep it by law.

rights.label: Your rights (access, erasure, objection...)
rights.quote: You are entitled to ask: for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, and details about how we are processing your personal information;

withdraw_consent.label: How to withdraw consent
withdraw_consent.quote: Consent – we only use your personal information for this purpose if you have asked us to do so. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

complain_to_regulator.label: Right to complain to the ICO
complain_to_regulator.quote: You also have the right to make a complaint to the supervisory authority if you’re not happy with how we’ve handled your personal information.
